title: Virtual Compute: snapshot debit — combined corrected amount
content:
## Calculation basis

Virtual Compute snapshot debit — Round the remote component half-up to two USD decimals and add it to the already rounded reviewed local snapshot subtotal to obtain the final corrected pretax amount; the local reduction does not apply to this remote component.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for snapshot debit — combined corrected amount?**

Round the remote component half-up to two USD decimals and add it to the already rounded reviewed local snapshot subtotal to obtain the final corrected pretax amount; the local reduction does not apply to this remote component.

## Hypothetical case

Hypothetically, the rounded local subtotal is 12.34 USD and the unrounded remote amount is 0.125 USD. Round the remote amount to 0.13 USD, then add it to obtain 12.47 USD. No local reduction acts on the remote amount.
